title: Concept: Customer information file number in a response
description: A customer information file number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The CIF ties every account, card and loan to one identity, and it is the number a call centre uses to look a customer up, so it is a direct impersonation aid.
applicability: Deployments that render a customer information file number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The CIF ties every account, card and loan to one identity, and it is the number a call centre uses to look a customer up, so it is a direct impersonation aid.
